headline: Teaching Gaussian Splats to understand 3D scenes, not just render them
achievements: Integrated CLIP language features for fine-grained semantic queries, enabling natural-language search over reconstructed 3D scenes
Fused CLIP semantics with DINOv2 spatial features for object localization and finer-grained scene understanding — not just geometry
Built a custom Gaussian Splatting pipeline from scratch for high-fidelity 3D scene reconstruction
Implemented multiple research papers into end-to-end pipelines for novel 3D reconstruction techniques
Researched city-scale Gaussian Splatting, focused on memory-efficient scene representations
description: Working on 3D Reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting, and adding features to it to make it more user friendly and efficient.

headline: Estimating material physics from pixels, not sensors
achievements: Researched and built a physics-estimation pipeline — inferring Young's Modulus, Poisson's ratio, density, and friction for reconstructed 3D objects (deformable and rigid) from visual features and surface texture alone, no contact sensing
Deployed the physics-estimation pipeline alongside the existing 3D reconstruction pipeline in production
Deployed Gaussian Splatting reconstruction on Kubernetes with dynamic GPU allocation (H100s, A100s, T4s), cutting processing time 30%
Designed and deployed an asynchronous job-scheduling platform on Argo Workflows for pipeline stability and reliability
Built Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and alerting, cutting failure response time 40%
description: Built physics estimation pipelines for 3D models, scaled Gaussian Splatting reconstruction on Kubernetes with GPU acceleration, and built production monitoring systems.

headline: 50% faster inference · 60% cost reduction · <500ms latency
achievements: Designed serverless inference platform on Kubernetes with NVIDIA Triton, holding <500ms latency under production load
Developed detection and segmentation architectures across Vision Transformers, Faster-RCNN, Mask-RCNN, and YOLO, tuned for outdoor field conditions
Optimized models for Jetson edge deployment, shrinking model size while holding accuracy
Built model caching that cut cold-start scale-up from 15-20 minutes to 3-4 seconds
description: Led CV team at an agriculture AI startup — custom model architectures, edge deployment on Jetson, distributed inference on Kubernetes. Five years of production constraints taught more about robustness than any textbook — the foundation the current robotics research builds on.
